name: SYNERGY II
question: Over 12 months in adults with wet overactive bladder, how do mirabegron plus solifenacin compare with either drug alone for safety and symptom control?

design.population: Adults with at least three months of wet overactive bladder symptoms, including urgency, frequency, and incontinence.
design.locator: Gratzke PDF pp502–504, Fig. 2; EU trial register, Period 1

verdictNote: Symptom comparisons were nominal; the primary safety objective had no formal between-group test.
takeaway: Over 12 months, mirabegron 50 mg plus solifenacin 5 mg improved daily incontinence and micturition counts more than either monotherapy in wet overactive bladder; treatment-emergent adverse events occurred in 49% versus 41% with mirabegron and 44% with solifenacin.
